title: Software Engineer, Frameworks & Libraries
description: About Thinking Machines The mission of Thinking Machines is to build AI that extends human will and judgment. We are training frontier models with Inkling, developing Tinker to let people make models their own, and crafting interfaces that broaden human-AI communication. We believe the future worth building is human, and we're hiring people who want to build it. About the Role We're hiring a Software Engineer, Frameworks & Libraries to turn the functionality we build internally into the open-source core libraries that the community builds on. You will package the code that powers our model launches and the Tinker Cookbook into well-designed, well-documented libraries, so that when we release a new model, researchers and developers can sample from it, post-train it, and evaluate it from day one. You will own the path from internal prototype to public library across the full stack of model-interaction primitives. Each layer builds on the one before it, so the interfaces you design need to compose cleanly, stay stable as models and training methods change, and hold up under real use by Tinker customers. This is a technical-first role at the boundary between research, infrastructure, and our open-source community. It's ideal for someone who cares about API design, backwards compatibility, and developer ergonomics, and who is just as comfortable reading a tokenizer's chat template as they are shipping a release.
